comment: The Net Yaroze target with the resident library replaced by psxsdk's exp/libps, a reimplementation in Go linked into the program, which then loads at 0x80010000 and owns the machine. Experimental: see docs/architecture/libps-go.md in psxsdk. LIBPS_GO empties the resident address table, so a library call the reimplementation lacks fails at link time by name, and the C library routines come from playstation-libc.c as they do for the plain playstation target.
